policy: Every curriculum is versioned independently by authority, programme, jurisdiction/university/board and academic year. Official source wins; unresolved items remain explicitly unresolved rather than being guessed.

sources.notes: Use the official Pharm.D Regulations attachments for the detailed course content; maintain separate versions for Pharm.D and Pharm.D (Post Baccalaureate).
PCI course-wise regulations lists the M.Pharm course regulations/amendments and the final scheme and syllabus. Specialisation must be represented as a separate configurable track.

sources.authority: Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh
sources.notes: The BTEUP syllabus portal identifies the two-year Diploma in Pharmacy annual-system syllabus. Do not replace it with a generic PCI D.Pharm structure when a UPBTE-specific version is required.

sources.authority: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
sources.notes: AKTU ILMS has a Pharmaceutical Science category and course resources. Exact university syllabus documents should be attached to a programme/version only after their official current syllabus document is verified.
GPAT 2026 bulletin states that the syllabus comprises subject/knowledge areas as per the B.Pharm Course Regulations, 2024. Keep this version separate from the PCI B.Pharm 2026 NEP syllabus.
